from collections import Counter
from math import gcd
from functools import reduce
code='''from collections import Counter
from math import gcd

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    common = {v for v, _ in counts.most_common(2)}
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marks = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in common]
    if not marks:
        return []
    rs = sorted({r for r, c in marks})
    cs = sorted({c for r, c in marks})
    dr = reduce(gcd, (b-a for a,b in zip(rs, rs[1:])), 0)
    dc = reduce(gcd, (b-a for a,b in zip(cs, cs[1:])), 0)
    if dr == 0: dr = 1
    if dc == 0: dc = 1
    rows = list(range(rs[0], rs[-1]+1, dr))
    cols = list(range(cs[0], cs[-1]+1, dc))
    out = []
    for r1, r2 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        row = []
        for c1, c2 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            vals = [grid[r1][c1], grid[r1][c2], grid[r2][c1], grid[r2][c2]]
            row.append(vals[0] if vals[0] not in common and all(v == vals[0] for v in vals) else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''

from math import gcd

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    common = [v for v, _ in counts.most_common(2)]
    # Grid-line color occupies complete periodic rows and columns; the other

    line_score = {}
    for color in common:
        row_hits = sum(sum(v == color for v in row) / w >= 0.8 for row in grid)
        col_hits = sum(sum(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h)) / h >= 0.8 for c in range(w))
        line_score[color] = row_hits + col_hits
    line_color = max(common, key=lambda color: line_score[color])
    background = next((color for color in common if color != line_color), line_color)
    marks = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in common]
